articles.author: DataMeds AI, Inc.
articles.headline: DataMEDS, AI. Acquires Helomics AI Cancer Diagnostics Lab and Precision Oncology CRO Businesses from Axe Compute
articles.summary: DataMEDS announces completion of the Helomics cancer-diagnostics laboratory and CRO business acquisition from Axe Compute, using common shares and an acquisition note for a stated $1.5 million purchase value. Acquired cash and laboratory assets are distinct from new operating revenue or clinical validation of AI diagnostics.
